sources.notes: Austin small business selling 100% ceremonial-grade matcha from Japan (shade grown, hand picked, stone ground). Stands at Texas Farmers' Market at Mueller on Sundays (10am-2pm) and Barton Creek or Bell (Cedar Park) on Saturdays; also retail at Local Pastures and wholesale/catering. Signature: matcha shot, iced matcha latte. Price and payment not published. Evidence: https://centralmatcha.com/pages/find-us
